h1: Viang Tak Riverside Hotel — river-view rooms in central Tak that punch above their price
intro: If you are visiting Tak and want to sleep right on the Ping River without paying a premium, Viang Tak Riverside Hotel is the long-standing name travellers mention most. It is a riverside hotel in the city centre on Chom Phon Road, where the river-side rooms look straight out over the Ping River and the Rattanakosin Bicentennial Bridge. There is an outdoor pool and a restaurant, and it is only a few minutes' walk to the riverside market and the Loi Krathong Sai festival site. Rooms start at around ฿800/night — good value for a river view like this.

body.html: What sets Viang Tak Riverside apart from other hotels in Tak is its riverside location in the city centre on Chom Phon Road. Higher river-side rooms look out over the Ping River and the Rattanakosin Bicentennial Bridge, the city's landmark span. What many guests love is that river-view rooms cost barely more than city-view ones — so just book the river side. From the hotel it is a short walk to the Ping River market and the riverbank where Tak holds its famous Loi Krathong Sai (floating thousand-lamp) festival.

The hotel is a multi-storey building with several room categories, from Superior up to family rooms. Rooms are fairly spacious with comfy beds, plump pillows, a work desk, a minibar fridge, a TV and a hot-water bathroom with a tub. Large glass windows take in the river view in full. Many guests say the rooms are bigger than expected and great value, especially a river-side room from the 6th floor up.
"Opened the curtains in the morning and the Ping River and the bridge were right there. The room was huge, the bed comfortable — you won't find a view like this in Tak at this price."

Beyond the rooms, the hotel has an outdoor pool and a kids' pool, a restaurant, a bar, a massage room, karaoke, billiards, free parking and free bicycles for riverside rides. Staff earn praise for being friendly and helpful. Breakfast is simple but has a decent spread — enough to fuel up before moving on, since many people use this place as an overnight stop on the drive north or out to Mae Sot.

To be straight with you: this hotel has been open a long time and is starting to show its age. Some rooms still have older carpet floors, towels and toiletries can look well-used, and conditioner or lotion is not always provided. The decor leans classic rather than modern. The area on the far bank of the river can look untidy in places too — worth knowing if you are expecting a brand-new property, as it may not match the photos in every corner.

Another point people raise is the in-house karaoke and bar, which can get noisy on some nights, so light sleepers should ask for a room away from that zone. Overall scores still hold up well — Agoda sits around 8.5 from over 1,500 reviews (couples rate it as high as ~9.3) and Trip.com is around 9.0 from 40 reviews. The numbers suggest most guests are happy with the location and view, and forgive the age.

In short, Viang Tak Riverside is a great pick for anyone who wants a Ping River-view room in central Tak on a light budget, or a one-night stop while travelling. You get a riverside view, a pool and a walkable location near the river market. If you can accept the building's age and a few missing toiletries, this place offers value that is hard to find in this town.

faqTitle: Frequently asked questions — Viang Tak Riverside Hotel, Tak

faq.q: Where is Viang Tak Riverside Hotel in Tak, and can you walk to the river?
faq.a: It sits at 236 Chom Phon Road, Rahaeng, on the Ping River in central Tak. The hotel is right on the riverbank, and river-side rooms look out over the Rattanakosin Bicentennial Bridge. It is a few minutes' walk to the Ping River market and the Loi Krathong Sai festival site.

faq.q: How much does Viang Tak Riverside Hotel cost, and what rooms are there?
faq.a: Standard Superior rooms start at around ฿800/night. Deluxe River View is about ฿1,005 (facing the Ping River and the bridge), and family rooms and suites for groups run roughly ฿1,400–฿1,800. Prices vary by season and package, so compare a few platforms before booking.

faq.q: Do all rooms at Viang Tak Riverside have a river view?
faq.a: Not every room. There are both river-view and city-view rooms, and the river-view ones cost barely more. If you want a full Ping River view, specify a 'River View room, 6th floor or higher' when booking and reconfirm before arrival.

faq.q: Does Viang Tak Riverside Hotel have a pool and parking?
faq.a: Yes — there is an outdoor pool, a kids' pool, and free parking. The hotel also has a restaurant, bar, massage room, karaoke and free bicycles for riverside rides. One thing to know: the karaoke/bar zone can be noisy on some nights, so light sleepers should ask for a room away from it.

faq.q: Who is Viang Tak Riverside Hotel best for, and how are the review scores?
faq.a: It suits couples, families and travellers who want a Ping River-view room on a light budget, or a road-trip overnight stop. Scores hold up well — Agoda is around 8.5 from over 1,500 reviews (couples rate it as high as ~9.3) and Trip.com is around 9.0 from 40 reviews. The main thing to know is that the hotel is long-established and shows its age.
